subject: SIG + SOC2 artifacts and dataflow questions for NimbleBank evaluation
messages:
From: Elaine Kovacs <elaine.kovacs@nimblebank.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimblebank.com
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SIG control mapping + SOC 2 artifacts for evaluation

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looks promising. Procurement and security have asked for a SIG control mapping and recent SOC 2 evidence so we can complete our procurement risk review. Specifically we need:

- A completed SIG control mapping (CSV or spreadsheet) showing coverage and compensating controls for in-scope controls.
- The latest SOC 2 Type II attestation and scope description.
- Sample evidence items where applicable (e.g., access review logs, config change tickets, KMS key rotation proof).
- A simple dataflow diagram showing where NimbleBank customer data is processed and which regions/storage are used.

Target timeline: can you provide the control mapping and a plan for artifacts by EOD 21 Nov? If you need an NDA or secure transfer channel, let procurement know (procurement@nimblebank.com).

Regards,
Elaine Kovacs
Director, Vendor Risk Management
NimbleBank

P.S. If there's a single point-of-contact on your side for evidence delivery, please loop them in.
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Kovacs <elaine.kovacs@nimblebank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SIG control mapping + SOC 2 artifacts for evaluation

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline.

Kimberly will take point on the SIG control mapping and will provide a marked spreadsheet with our assertions and references to evidence. Priyom will coordinate artifact delivery and a secure upload. We can commit to the control mapping file by 21 Nov and preliminary artifacts the same week; if we need extra time for redactions we’ll call that out.

For the dataflow diagram, we have a standard customer-dataflow diagram (we can annotate it for NimbleBank’s expected flows) — Kimberly will include that.

SPOC for this work: kimberly_park@redwood.com (Technical Assurance Lead).

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Kovacs <elaine.kovacs@nimblebank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: SIG control mapping and coverage notes (initial delivery)

Hi Elaine — attaching our initial SIG control mapping (redwood_SIG_control_mapping_20251118.xlsx). High-level notes below:

- Scope: Hosted API (public tier) + Dedicated capacity (customer-owned VPC) are both included where controls apply. We annotated each SIG control row with: coverage (Yes/Partial/No), control owner, evidence reference, and redaction notes.
- SOC 2: Our latest SOC 2 Type II (period Jan–Dec 2024) covers the majority of SIG common controls — the full PDF is attached as SOC2-TypeII-Report-2024.pdf.
- Evidence examples we will provide: access review exports (IAM console CSV), sample change request (Jira RED-1234, redaction applied), KMS rotation logs (audit entries), and a telemetry sample (anonymized).
- Data residency: we operate with regional options; production workloads for US customers are primarily in us-west-2 by default. We flagged controls that depend on region-specific storage.

Next steps we propose:
1) We’ll upload the full evidence packet to a secure folder and share links to the items that can be shared without additional legal review.
2) For artifacts that require legal review/redaction (personally identifying support tickets, for example), we’ll mark them and provide a schedule for redaction delivery.

Attachments: redwood_SIG_control_mapping_20251118.xlsx, SOC2-TypeII-Report-2024.pdf

—
Kimberly Park
Technical Assurance Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Elaine Kovacs <elaine.kovacs@nimblebank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement@nimblebank.com
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG control mapping and coverage notes (initial delivery)

Thanks Kimberly — that’s a helpful start. A few clarifying items before we accept the packet: 

On Tue, Nov 18, 2025 at 8:45 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elaine — attaching our initial SIG control mapping (redwood_SIG_control_mapping_20251118.xlsx).

Could you also include:
- A simple PNG/PDF dataflow diagram annotated for where NimbleBank data (PII, financial records) resides and which systems/processes have access? (You mentioned region; we also need the S3 bucket/DB identifiers as a reference).
- A sample of retention policy enforcement logs (we don’t need full records — a redacted sample showing purge run times and the policy id is sufficient).
- Confirmation on whether any processing is performed outside the US for NimbleBank-account data. If so, please list the regions and the minimal set of controls that differ.

Procurement: if you require an NDA before we accept links, let us know. Otherwise we prefer secure link delivery (S3 presigned or SharePoint).

Best,
Elaine

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Kovacs <elaine.kovacs@nimblebank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence delivery plan and secure upload instructions

Hi Elaine — thanks for the checklist. Quick update on what we’ll deliver and how: 

1) Dataflow diagram (annotated) — attached as dataflow_diagram_v2.png (we’ll also include the editable Visio on request).
2) Retention enforcement sample — redacted CSV showing purge job id, timestamp, policy id (we will mark PII redacted).
3) Regional processing confirmation — production for NimbleBank accounts will remain in us-west-2; no customer data is routed to non-US regions unless explicitly configured by the customer. We’ve added a short note in the control mapping spreadsheet where region affects control applicability.

Secure delivery: we’ve created a short-lived secure upload bucket and a folder for NimbleBank. Upload instructions are attached (upload_instructions.txt). You can also use the secure link below; access is scoped to procurement@nimblebank.com for 7 days.

Secure upload: https://s3-secure-upload.example.com/nimblebank/20251119

If you’d prefer a managed transfer, we can send a SharePoint invite or a Box link — let me know.

Attachments: dataflow_diagram_v2.png, upload_instructions.txt

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Elaine Kovacs <elaine.kovacs@nimblebank.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Kim Nguyen <procurement@nimblebank.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence delivery plan and secure upload instructions

Priyom — received, thank you. We’ll attempt the upload today. Two quick items: 

- Procurement would like documentation that the upload endpoint is isolated and that only scoped users can access the folder (a short security note is fine).
- Can we schedule a 30-min call to review the mapping and the key artifacts (SOC 2, KMS proof, retention sample) on Monday 24 Nov? We’re in PST; suggested window 10–12 PST.

If Monday is tight, Wed 26 Nov in the afternoon also works.

Once upload is validated, procurement will begin the internal review thread and flag any items that need redaction.

Best,
Elaine Kovacs
Director, Vendor Risk Management
NimbleBank
